primary_contrast: wrong-object delivery rate, no_shield versus oracle_sim_shield (ceiling) and sensor_shield, on the same adversary graph and seeds

excluded_from_primary_contrast.rule: an episode in which budget-guard raised a violation with kind in {limit, velocity, workspace, watchdog} before the first semantic refusal; the guard, not the shield, altered the proposal
excluded_from_primary_contrast.evidence: budget-guard/violation trace rows and shield_events.jsonl ordering

excluded_from_primary_contrast.rule: a semantic refusal whose held command was also clamped by the guard in the same turn; the semantic decision cannot be separated from the kinematic one
excluded_from_primary_contrast.evidence: guard clamp record at the same sim_time_ns as the refusal

excluded_from_primary_contrast.rule: an assertion the authorizer rejected as malformed, unregistered, time-regressing or future-dated
a permit the gateway refused for a reason other than a semantic one (replayed, expired, wrong stage/proposal/episode/revision/carrier)
episode without a verdict because a node died or the turn watchdog expired

retained: every excluded episode stays in the record with its class; exclusions are counted and reported beside the contrast
not_credited_to_the_shield: guard interventions and containment events in any arm
